cards.front: Recall a key point about Homeostasis and the Nervous System
cards.back: Negative feedback: deviation -> correction (e.g. blood glucose, temp, water); Positive: amplifies (e.g. oxytocin in childbirth)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Homeostasis and the Nervous System
cards.back: Kidney: cortex/medulla; nephron (Bowman's capsule, PCT, loop of Henle, DCT, collecting duct); ADH: increases water permeability of DCT/CD; Loop: counter-current multiplier creates medullary gradient

cards.front: Recall a key point about Homeostasis and the Nervous System
cards.back: Neurones: sensory, relay, motor; Resting potential -70mV (Na⁺/K⁺ pump, K⁺ leak); Action potential: depolarisation (Na⁺ in), repolarisation (K⁺ out), refractory period

cards.front: Recall a key point about Homeostasis and the Nervous System
cards.back: Synapse: Ca^2⁺ -> vesicle fusion -> neurotransmitter -> receptor -> depolarisation; Summation: temporal/spatial

cards.front: Recall a key point about Homeostasis and the Nervous System
cards.back: Hormones: insulin (β-cells, lowers glucose), glucagon (α-cells, raises glucose), adrenaline (fight/flight), thyroxine (metabolic rate); Diabetes: type 1 (no insulin), type 2 (insulin resistance)
